ns2:course.label: Statics & Dynamics
ns2:course.description: Study of equilibrium of rigid bodies in two and three dimensions; trusses; shear and bending moments in beams; arches and frames; cables; friction; introduction to dynamics; architectural applications. Prerequisite: MATH 220 or MATH 221; and MATH 231 or PHYS 101.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MATH 220 or MATH 221; and MATH 231 or PHYS 101.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one lab and one lecture section.
